newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks dip at noon on new accounts day.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks dip at noon on new accounts day.

text.p: Pakistani stocks dipped at noon on Thursday as investors and institutions stayed on the sidelines on the new accounts day, and dealers said sentiment would remain weak in the near-term.

"Pakistan's grim economic outlook will keep the market under pressure in the near-term," a dealer said. "There is little interest from genuine investors and only speculators are active." The Karachi 100-share index fell 5.27 points, or 0.35 percent, to 1,520.68 at noon. Losers beat gainers 148 to 45. Lever Brothers fell 7.0 rupees to 693.
